periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation relative to the tilted facial midline, approximately perpendicular to the trans-orbital axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid, with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering towards the muzzle, creating a teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, extending across approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial crown.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular curvature at the superior edges of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lateral head tilt of approximately 45 degrees relative to the torso.
